title: ShiftQAT: Quantization-Aware Training for the Numerical Contract of a Fixed-Function Edge CNN Accelerator
abstract: arXiv:2610.21695v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fixed-function CNN accelerators make edge inference fast and energy-efficient, but they execute only networks that obey a precise numerical contract. On the MAX7800x family, this contract requires power-of-two, per-tensor, symmetric scales, 8-bit activations and biases, integer-only arithmetic, and one statically configured shift per layer. We present ShiftQAT, the quantization-aware training (QAT) flow we developed for this family, which produces networks satisfying the contract by construction. It is the default training path of ai8x-training, the family's open-source training toolchain. ShiftQAT resolves residual, concatenation, and weight-sharing dependencies so that activation scales propagate statically and each layer's requantization reduces to one offline-configured shift. translated_title: ShiftQAT：面向固定功能边缘CNN加速器数值契约的量化感知训练
translated_abstract: 固定功能CNN加速器使边缘推理快速且节能，但它们只能执行符合精确数值契约的网络。在MAX7800x系列上，该契约要求采用二的幂次、逐张量、对称的缩放因子，8位激活值与偏置，仅整数的算术运算，以及每层一个静态配置的移位操作。我们提出ShiftQAT，这是我们为该系列开发的量化感知训练（QAT）流程，能够通过构造方式生成满足该契约的网络。它是该系列开源训练工具链ai8x-training的默认训练路径。ShiftQAT解决了残差、拼接和权重共享的依赖关系，使激活缩放因子能够静态传播，并将每层的重量化简化为一次离线配置的移位。它还在符合8位偏置预算的联合二的幂次网格上训练权重和偏置。在所比较的方法中，只有ShiftQAT满足所有的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ShiftQAT是一种面向MAX7800x系列固定功能边缘CNN加速器的量化感知训练流程，通过构造方式生成满足二的幂次对称缩放、8位仅整数运算等数值契约的神经网络，是该系列开源训练工具链ai8x-training的默认训练路径。
en_tdlr: ShiftQAT is a quantization-aware training flow for the MAX7800x fixed-function edge CNN accelerator family that produces networks satisfying their numerical contract (power-of-two symmetric scales, 8-bit integer-only arithmetic) by construction, serving as the default training path of the open-source ai8x-training toolchain.
